packageRules.description: Base image digests are a deliberate bump, never automatic - a rebuilt Fedora base is a new OS under every node.
One PR for all the bootc bases rather than one per image.

Nextcloud majors follow upstream's own production channel, not the highest tag. A major here is an irreversible database migration on a live instance, and a .0 reaches `latest` long before it reaches `production` - 35.0.0 did exactly that. `pin_apps.py --channel` fails when this cap goes stale, so it is raised on purpose rather than remembered.
